transcript: I've been at TIFF for the last five days with TikTok, and it's genuinely been one of the most exciting and fulfilling weeks of my entire life. I've seen so many movies, I've met incredible people, and today is the final day of the cohort. And it started with one of the craziest things I've ever gotten to do. I was on the red carpet for Elsinore. I was so nervous about it, and then it ended up being not scary at all. Oh, I did so much prep, but it actually went so fast. But because this is a movie about theater, I really wanted to approach it from that direction cause I felt like no one else was going to. So I talked to Monica Dolan and Johnny Flynn and Billy Piper. They're all about theater and the theater community. And then Andrew Scott walked in. I absolutely adore him. They basically told me I had 30 seconds to ask him one question. So obviously I asked him about theater, and he seemed so genuinely excited to talk and gave such a thoughtful answer, and I was trying to remain so professional. I think I did okay. Quickly packed up and headed into the theater for the premiere of Elsinore. And it absolutely destroyed me. I loved it. It's heartbreaking, but also very funny and beautiful. It's a movie about theater and the theater community and found family and artists taking care of each other. It's so good. And give Andrew Scott the Oscar. I grabbed an actual sit down lunch with my friend Anuba, which was amazing. Then had to change into a nice outfit because I was going to the Getty photo studio. These are the official TIFF portraits that every celebrity takes. And now me. Do I know how to pose? No. Was my dress a little too big? Yes. But it was actually a really good time. We got some group photos, and I just cannot wait to see how they all turn out. And it worked out that I was already dressed up, because from there, we were going to the IMDB TIFF party. Any film kid will tell you that IMDB is the best. And this was so fun. It was on the roof of the Bisha Hotel. It was an incredible view. There was a great food and desserts, including some mores. This was our official final event of the trip, and it was the perfect way to celebrate everything we had gotten to do, all the incredible experiences that we had had. And Kat Sandler and some of the cast of Yago were being honored, and I was, like, freaking out, so excited. And speaking of, this is not the end of my TIFF experience, because while TikTok ends now, I'm staying for a few more days because I still had a lot of things that I wanted to see. So I said goodbye to my new friends and thanks. TikTok truly thank you so much! And headed back to the theater for the premiere of Alice, Pioneer of cinema. Now this is a new T. V. Show that is going to be on crave this winter. I hope it has a U. S. Distributor though because I loved it. We watched the first two episodes. It's about Alice Ghee, the first ever female film director. It has a stacked cast including Bernice Burgos. Who is Alice? She was in the artist. Our boy Francois Arnaud has a small role, but I love him. I then headed back to the hotel because I had to pack cause I'm checking out of the hotel and headed to a friend's house. Thankfully we have a few more adventures to come!
